data.name: Khushdil
data.gender_notes: Khushdil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khushdil is a warm and beautiful name from Persian and Urdu, meaning 'happy-hearted' or 'cheerful'. It represents someone who carries joy within and spreads smiles and peace wherever they go. The name Khushdil carries the meaning “Happy-hearted, Cheerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Khushdil usually hope their child will grow to embody happy-hearted, cheerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A peaceful soul who uplifts others through happiness and compassion — like sunshine in human form.
data.etymology: Khushdil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy-hearted, Cheerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khushdil total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خُشْدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: خُشْدل بِسَلامِ اللَّهِ، مَفْهَمُهُ قَالْبٌ فَرِحٌ، وَسَعَادَةٌ قَلْبِيَةٌ، يُنَسَبُ إِلَى رَوْتِهِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ، كَوْشِدَلَةٌ، الَّتِيْ تُقْصَدُ بِهَا الْفَرْحَ وَالسَّعَادَةَ. فِي الْقُرآنِ الْكَرِيمِ نَجِدُ مَفْهَمَ الْفَرْحِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ بِمُوَافَقَةِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى، وَأَوْلِيَاءِهِ، وَفِيهِ دُعَاءٌ لِلعْبَادِ بِالسَّعَادَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ.

in_urdu.name: خوشدل
in_urdu.meaning: خوش دل، دلِ شاد، خوشی کا دل
in_urdu.long_meaning: خوشدل، اس نام کا معنی ہے خوش دل، خوشی سے بھرا ہوا دل۔ یہ نام عربی لفظ ‘خوشدل’ سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور مسرت۔ اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت ہے کہ خوشی، مسرت اور فرحت کے ساتھ ساتھ نیک خواہشوں اور اچھے کاموں کے لیے ترغیب بھی دیتی ہے۔ اس نام کو اسلامی تہذیب میں خوشی اور سعادت کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खुशदिल
in_hindi.long_meaning: खुशदिल एक ऐसा नाम है जिसका अर्थ है खुश मन, प्रसन्न हृदय। यह नाम अरबी मूल के शब्द 'खुशदिल' से आया है जिसका अर्थ है खुशी और प्रसन्नता। इस नाम से जुड़ी आध्यात्मिक महत्व यह है कि यह खुशी, प्रसन्नता और उमंग के साथ-साथ अच्छे विचारों और अच्छे कर्मों के लिए प्रोत्साहन भी देता है। इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में खुशी और सुख के लिए किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: خوشدل
in_pashto.long_meaning: خوشدل په پښتو کې د خوشى او شير دل ته اشاره کوي. دغه نوم په عربي ژبه کې د خوشدل لفظ له لارښوونې جوړه شوې ده، چې د خوشى او شادى ته اشاره کوي. خوشدل نوم د اسلامي مذهب کې خوشى، شير او مسرت ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Khushdil
in_english.long_meaning: Khushdil, an Arabic name meaning 'happy-hearted' or 'cheerful.' It is derived from the root word 'khush,' meaning 'joy' or 'happiness,' and 'dil,' meaning 'heart.' In Islamic tradition, Khushdil symbolizes a heart filled with joy, contentment, and spiritual serenity. It is often associated with kindness, generosity, and a cheerful disposition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khushdil carries a rich Persian and Urdu heritage, reflecting a vibrant cultural background. It is a reminder of the importance of inner happiness and positive attitude in various aspects of life. The name is also used as a term of endearment, expressing warmth, love, and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khushdil is a reminder of the peaceful and joyous presence of Allah (God) in our lives. The name encourages us to radiate happiness and contentment, just as Allah does, and bring positivity to ourselves and to those around us. Khushdil represents the beautiful qualities of being gentle, cheerful, and approachable, reflecting the spiritual essence of a true believer.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Khushdil is derived from the Persian words "Khush" meaning happiness and "Dil" meaning heart. This name symbolizes a heart that is always filled with joy and happiness, spreading positivity and contentment in one's surroundings. Khushdil is a reminder to maintain a joyful and cheerful disposition, even in difficult times.
